title: Meridian Vale Industries: m and a review (fictional)

documents.title: Information memorandum
documents.text:
Information memorandum — Meridian Vale Industries (fictional).
In this document "MVIH" means Meridian Vale Industries. Meridian Vale Industries reports normalised net working capital of $49m for FY2024 on a reported basis under the original agreement. Meridian Logistics subsidiary reports EBITDA of $108m for FY2024 on a reported basis. MVIH reports revenue of $370.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Industries reports gross margin of 34.9% for FY2024. For Meridian Vale Industries, the leakage definition is read as: permitted leakage excludes management bonuses. The fiscal year of Meridian Vale Industries ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Financial due diligence report
documents.text:
Financial due diligence report — Meridian Vale Industries (fictional).
Meridian Vale Industries reports normalised net working capital of $39.1m for FY2024 on a reported basis under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Meridian Vale Industries reports EBITDA of $99.3m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Industries reports earn out of $70.1m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Industries reports headcount of 581 for LTM to 30 Jun 2025. For Meridian Vale Industries, the leakage definition is read as: management bonuses are permitted leakage up to $2m.

documents.title: Draft share purchase agreement
documents.text:
Draft share purchase agreement — Meridian Vale Industries (fictional).
Meridian Vale Industries reports revenue of $306.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Industries reports gross profit margin of 42.3% for FY2024. Meridian Vale Industries reports earn out of USD 80.7 million for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Industries reports headcount of 711 for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). "gross profit margin" has the same meaning as "gross margin".
